ownership.quote: PoplarML lets you deploy any machine learning model to a fleet of GPUs as a ready-to-use and scalable API endpoint with one command.

stage.quote: Winter 2023 Active ... San Francisco Company Jobs 0
stage.note: Only confirmed capital is participation in YC's Winter 2023 batch (implying YC's standard pre-seed investment). No subsequent priced round (seed, series A, etc.) was found in press, HN, or search; treated as pre-seed rather than unknown because YC batch participation is confirmed, but no specific amount for YC's own check could be confirmed for this company.

note: YC W23 company (co-founders Danna Liu and Evan Chu, ex-Snap/Stripe/Coinbase/Microsoft/PagerDuty/Amazon/AWS engineers) offering one-command CLI deployment of ML models (TensorFlow/PyTorch/JAX) to GPU-backed REST inference endpoints. YC directory still lists it as 'Active' with team size 2 and website http://poplarml.com, confirming this is the same company as the card's domain. However the live product appears defunct as of 2026-09-30: poplarml.com/www TLS certs expired 2025-02-07, the S3-backed CloudFront origin returns NoSuchBucket, app/docs/api subdomains no longer resolve, and Wayback's last successful homepage capture was 2024-04-21 (every capture since 2024-09-18 is a 404). No funding round beyond YC's own investment, and no revenue figures, could be found anywhere (searches on DuckDuckGo/Bing/Google/Crunchbase were blocked or returned nothing; no TechCrunch or HN Launch coverage of a raise exists). Buyers should treat this as a likely-defunct micro-startup with unconfirmed financials beyond YC batch participation.
